Quickfire Guide
How Do I Choose the Correct Route?
heading_path: How Do I Choose the Correct Route?

content_blocks.text: Route 1 provides guidance and templates for procurements that are:
heading_path: How Do I Choose the Correct Route?

content_blocks.text: low value (a total estimated value of under £50k excluding VAT)
heading_path: How Do I Choose the Correct Route?

content_blocks.text: low risk and
heading_path: How Do I Choose the Correct Route?

content_blocks.text: non-repetitive.
heading_path: How Do I Choose the Correct Route?

content_blocks.text: Route 2 provides guidance and templates for procurements that are:
heading_path: How Do I Choose the Correct Route?

content_blocks.text: regulated procurements
heading_path: How Do I Choose the Correct Route?

content_blocks.text: between £50k and up to the GPA Procurement threshold
heading_path: How Do I Choose the Correct Route?

content_blocks.text: Route 3 provides guidance and templates for procurements that are:
heading_path: How Do I Choose the Correct Route?

content_blocks.text: regulated procurements; as defined in the Procurement Reform (Scotland) Act 2014
heading_path: How Do I Choose the Correct Route?

content_blocks.text: equal to the GPA Procurement threshold and above
heading_path: How Do I Choose the Correct Route?

content_blocks.text: In the case of a lotted contract, the estimated value shall be the total estimated value of all such lots.
heading_path: How Do I Choose the Correct Route?

content_blocks.text: If you are unable to estimate the value of a contract that contract will be explicitly made subject to the procurement rules and you should take advice from your own legal advisers or your Centre of Expertise.
heading_path: How Do I Choose the Correct Route?

content_blocks.text: The 3 different Procurement Journey Routes are designed to give you options that are proportionate to the risk and value of the procurement exercise that you are conducting.
heading_path: How Do I Choose the Correct Route?

content_blocks.text: Please refer to Procurement Threshold and Estimated Contract Value for more information on how to calculate your contract value.
heading_path: How Do I Choose the Correct Route?
